summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by capturing agentic journeys through QuadratureNexus and FLUME VAE into SurrealDB, analyzing them via Ouroboros and Mycelium for closed-loop feedback, then running an overnight autonomous improvement session using teams of specialist agents to fix test failures and add compound engineering improvements.
summary.outcome: Implemented E1-E76 autoresearch experiments with the Mycelium additive calibration fix (E57) enabling monotonic consensus compounding toward HIHO threshold; reduced test failures from ~280 to ~42; created a compound analytics subsystem with 10+ new modules; fixed FLUME VAE signature unification and ~100 pre-existing test failures across universe, cache, inference, integrations, patterns, and graph modules.

repo: autoresearch.jsonl stores experiment results at r['asi']['experiment'], r['status'], r['metric'] — NOT r['experiment'], r['verdict'], r['delta']
KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 env var required for commits touching Kaggle competition files on main branch
COHEZION_ALLOW_INSECURE_SURREAL=1 bypasses SurrealDB credential check; COHEZION_STRICT_AXIS=1 makes symmetry bridge failures fatal
The Entire.io checkpoint daemon periodically reverts working tree to HEAD — workaround is git checkout HEAD -- <file>
conftest.py mocks sentence_transformers.SentenceTransformer with MagicMock to prevent AMD ROCm hardware segfaults — all tests expecting real ST embeddings must be skipped with requires_real_st marker

Global conftest.py mocks transformers but leaves PreTrainedTokenizer as MagicMock, causing FlumeTokenizer.__call__ to return MagicMock objects with empty .items() — fix by exposing PreTrainedTokenizer as real

SurrealDB requires time::now() for datetime fields (not string literals), RETURN true; for health probe (SELECT 1; returns 400), and metadata must use result field (option<string>) due to SCHEMAFULL blocking arbitrary subfields
QuadratureNexus._score_adjustments is unconditionally overwritten per deliberation in run_llm_deliberation() — _mycelium_calibration is the correct cross-cycle persistent store
log_result() in overnight_evo_loop.py takes 6 positional args: (run: int, metric: float, metrics: dict, status: str, description: str, experiment: str)
Pre-commit stash/restore conflicts with autoresearch.jsonl (LFS pointer vs actual content) — fix with git rm --cached autoresearch.jsonl and add to .gitignore
psutil mock must cover BOTH virtual_memory AND cpu_percent; mocking only memory still blocks tests when CPU is at 99% from background agents
HIHO balance threshold is exactly 0.5: exploit when coherence >= 0.5, explore when below — same threshold governs AutoresearchEngine.generate_next_experiments() mode selection

code.finding: run_llm_deliberation() unconditionally SETs _score_adjustments[vt] = (llm_score - base) + mycelium_calib on every call, wiping any Mycelium adjustments. Cross-cycle calibration must use _mycelium_calibration += (additive) while _score_adjustments is per-deliberation read surface.

FlumeVAE now has dual-mode: token transformer (production via FlumeVAEConfig) and legacy MLP embedding mode (FlumeVAE(input_dim=768, latent_dim=256)). forward() always returns 4 values: (recon, mu, log_var, z). reparameterize() returns mu deterministically in eval mode.

Was unpacking 4 values from self.model(data) but FlumeVAE.forward() was returning 3. Fixed by adding z back to forward return. Also: reconstruction cosine similarity for token models requires argmax projection: recon.argmax(dim=-1).float()

AxiomaticState.check_precipitation() implements Smith precipitation gate: HIHO threshold (coherence>0.5) + Shannon entropy H=-p*log2(p)-(1-p)*log2(1-p) + thermodynamic F=E-TS. Must use explicit bool() casts on numpy bool_ returns or isinstance checks fail.

download_dataset() now returns bytes from REST API (breaking change). Callers expecting a Path should use download_dataset_path() instead. download_dataset_path() must use asyncio.to_thread(kagglehub.competition_download, ...) to avoid blocking the event loop.

Defensive guard for missing input_ids from FlumeTokenizer must raise ValueError not return torch.zeros() sentinel. Sentinel values violate CLAUDE.md and cause silent wrong-answer failures. The root cause (tokenizer returning empty) is fixed by exposing PreTrainedTokenizer as real in conftest.py.
flush_all() must cancel pending _flush_batch tasks before executing its own flush to prevent double-counting (4 calls instead of 3). Use asyncio.all_tasks() filtering on task name.

compound_score in ExecutionResult was added as field with default 0.0 but was never computed. The formula coherence * hiho_stability * skill_factor must be wired in just before the return statement where metrics are available.

log_result() signature: (run: int, metric: float, metrics: dict, status: str, description: str, experiment: str, **extra). E71-E76 were calling with wrong 4-arg order. run = int(time.time()*1000), status = 'keep' if delta > 0 else 'discard'.

set_lever_position() must use write-ahead store pattern (accept override before rule exists) not lookup-then-write. _lever_overrides dict stores (rule_id, lever_name) -> value, enabling override before rule is loaded.

analyze_cache_effectiveness() had sync/async flip that broke two test files — restored to async. Two test files had conflicting expectations: test_cache_warmer.py uses async def test, test_cache_warmer_integration.py needs asyncio.run() wrapper.

workflow: Surgical commit strategy: run ruff format + ruff check --select=F,E9,E501 --fix manually before staging; git add <specific_files> not -A; KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 for competition-touched files
MagicMock side_effects in async contexts cause StopIteration becoming RuntimeError in Python 3.10+; always use AsyncMock for async methods
Property-based tests with @pytest.mark.parametrize over ranges (n=1,2,3,5,10,20) catch contract violations that single example tests miss
V-model structural invariant tests using inspect.signature() at ~1ms each catch refactor drift (renamed params, changed defaults) before behavioral tests run
Tests that call singleton resource monitors (psutil CPU/memory) fail under CI load — add autouse conftest fixture mocking both psutil.virtual_memory and psutil.cpu_percent
JEPA world model learning is bounded by input distribution diversity — heuristic mode produces single-attractor distribution preventing JEPA from generalizing; needs LLM mode variance
When a provider class is removed from a module, tests patching it by module path break at fixture setup time as ERRORs not FAILUREs — remove patch entirely and use constructor flags instead
Pre-commit stash/restore race condition: if a test writes runtime data (autoresearch.jsonl) to a tracked file path, pre-commit stash fails on restore; solution is git rm --cached + .gitignore
Retirement criterion for experiments: CV(last-10-keeps) < 0.05 AND n_keeps >= 20 → converged (retire); OR n_total >= 20 AND n_keeps == 0 → noise (retire)
The convergence formula for Mycelium compounding is: consensus_n = 0.85 - 0.125 * (1 - lr/2)^n, max_error=0.00025, asymptotic limit = HIHO threshold exactly

asyncio.run() in nested async contexts raises RuntimeError 'event loop already running' — vault sync wrappers need loop detection (get_running_loop) and loop.create_task() fallback
Multiple experiment functions (E71-E76) used wrong log_result() call signature discovered only at runtime since Python doesn't enforce positional arg count
The 6-arg log_result() signature is non-obvious and inconsistent with Python conventions — missing type annotations made the argument order ambiguous
ruff-quick hook was auto-fixing staged files during pre-commit stash phase, causing stash restore to fail with 'File exists' conflicts
